scope: Refuse persisted transfer markers across registered managers before exclusion and permanently invalidate an issued owner after observed transfer uncertainty.
limitations: Observed renderer-state admission only; no state/marker writes, release, reset or native dispatch.
Before-reservation refusal creates no owner; a clean new observation may be checked again.
After-issued-owner uncertainty is sticky for this loaded class; marker disappearance cannot revive it.
Other state writers may act between observations; no global state lease, filesystem custody, persistence acknowledgement or restart recovery.
